hypotheses.justification: Openness supplies the continuous coset factorization needed for Shapiro without total disconnectedness: Subgroup.exists_continuous_rightCosetFactorization_of_isOpen requires only a topological group. Use it instead of exists_continuous_rightCosetFactorization in the proofs of coindMap_surjective and bijective_explicitShapiroMap1. Their remaining steps need no total disconnectedness. These open-subgroup versions give exact coinduction and degree-one Shapiro; the dimension-shifting proof in Shapiro/AllDegrees.lean then gives Shapiro in every degree without this instance. Consequently the proof of the closed-subgroup inequality can be repeated for this open U, and the trace/descent proof supplies the reverse inequality as before. Compactness, openness and hG remain available. The constructions work for trivial groups and all p, including 0 and 1; no additional nontriviality or primality assumption is needed.
